answer_text: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN on an AWS Frankfurt IPsec tunnel usually indicates a mismatch in IPsec phase 1/2 proposals between Cato and the gateway. Start by opening the IPSec Timeline for the Frankfurt VGW and download the CSV to locate the NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN entry. The Timeline can reveal p1/p2 transform mismatches, so verify that the chosen P1 and P2 transforms match both your Cato site configuration and AWS settings. Ensure AWS IPsec settings align with Cato’s default cloud-provider settings and, if needed, use packet captures to pinpoint the control-traffic mismatch.
